title: An et al. 2020, Cerium-doped indium oxide transparent electrode for semi-transparent perovskite and tandem cells (Solar Energy 196)
notes: ICO and ITO films, ~100 nm, RF sputtered at RT to 200 °C; ICO-150 and ICO-200/ITO-200 are named in text/Table 1, the 50/100 °C films only in figures.
Power is given only as a density (2.6 W/cm2), so sputtering_power (W) has no gold value.
Traps: Hall measured at 22 °C, J-V at 25 °C, 80 nm evaporated ITO tunnel junction, ~10 Ω/sq commercial ITO glass, 9 nm MoOx.
Fig. 4a inset text (T550 and Rsheet) is recorded as figure_only.
